rankingBasis: Ranked by count of Michelin-listed restaurants on-site (per official release). Ties (1 listing each) are ordered arbitrarily and flagged for review. Venetian count includes Mott 32, which the release places at The Palazzo (adjacent to The Venetian).
transitReality: Las Vegas has NO subway/metro. Public transit = RTC buses (the Deuce runs the full Strip 24/7; ~$4 single / $8 24-hr pass) + Las Vegas Monorail (east Strip only, ~$5.50 single / ~$13.45 day pass). "Within 1 hour by bus" is satisfied for every Strip hotel-to-Michelin-restaurant pairing. Chinatown/Spring Mountain and Arts District spots are a short rideshare or bus ride from central Strip hotels.
